title: NoGrass Manhunt
description: Normal Manhunt plugin but i blocked the grass block. (it's for my video)
body: Minecraft Manhunt is a challenge where one player (the speedrunner) tries to beat the game as fast as possible, while others (the hunters) try to stop them. If the runner kills the Ender Dragon first, they win. If the hunters kill the runner, they win. But in this data pack you can't touch the grass block.
